description: Header file defining internal functions and macros for ARMv7-M MPU configuration in Zephyr OS, including region initialization, validation, and configuration routines.

methods.name: mpu_init
methods.description: Initializes MPU configuration at system startup; currently no specific setup.

methods.name: region_init
methods.description: Initializes a specific MPU region with given configuration.

methods.name: mpu_partition_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a memory partition's start address and size are valid for MPU.

methods.name: size_to_mpu_rasr_size
methods.description: Converts a size to the corresponding MPU_RASR size field value, rounding up if necessary.

methods.name: get_region_attr_from_mpu_partition_info
methods.description: Generates region attribute settings from partition info.

methods.name: get_dyn_region_min_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum MPU region index for dynamic regions (static regions count).

methods.name: is_user_accessible_region
methods.description: Checks if a region is accessible by user mode with optional write permission.

methods.name: mpu_buffer_validate
methods.description: Validates if a memory buffer is accessible with current MPU settings.

methods.name: mpu_configure_region
methods.description: Configures a specific MPU region with new partition info.

methods.name: mpu_configure_regions
methods.description: Configures multiple MPU regions starting from a specific index.

methods.name: mpu_configure_static_mpu_regions
methods.description: Programs static MPU regions during system initialization.

methods.name: mpu_configure_dynamic_mpu_regions
methods.description: Programs dynamic MPU regions at runtime.
